segments.text:
V. 38.
Beware of the ſcribes—There was an abſolute Neceſſity for theſe repeated Cautions. For conſidering their inveterate Prejudices againſt Chriſt, it could never be ſuppoſed the common People would receive the Goſpel, till theſe incorrigible Blaſphemers of it, were brought to juſt Diſgrace.

Yet he delayed ſpeaking in this Manner till a little before his Paſſion, as knowing what Effect it would quickly produce. Nor is this any Precedent for Us: We are not inveſted with the ſame Authority.
